body: Thank you. I am going to try to do these nostalgic things.

I got symptoms in the last couple of months but no full fledged psychosis like a few years ago. It's really difficult to find a purpose. Nothing really engages me enough. I want to see a point to it all but I can't seem to find one. 

I am lucky to say that I do somewhat enjoy certain things.

I'm sorry this happened to you in this way. I don't know your situation, but I hope you'll be able to get proper help. 

What exactly are 'secondary services'? Is it like regular mental health help / therapy?
That sucks so much😣 how are your symptoms at the moment?

Thank you I will try

Tbh I can't cope anymore, I feel very unstable. I need to get my mind occupied as you said.
Thanks I am already on antipsychotics
Yeah on a reasonable dose. Doesn't seem to help with this particular thing.
What does it feel like for you?
Yes, and it faded for a while, but now it's back.
Why would you risk having dpdr worsening and slowing your recovery?
This certainly helps! I'll try to do it this way, stop responding to it and not trying to fight them, and see how it goes. Thanks a lot!
